t: DEWALT bi-material nail punch set contains 3 punches with 0.8, 1.5 and 2.4mm tips, making it suitable for a range of applications. Each hardened steel nail punch features a bi-material, flared grip, engineered for enhanced comfort and effective shock absorption, and colour-coded tips for quick size identification. The punches also feature solid steel cores to provide direct energy transfer for accurate driving.
